en.h1: What Does E92 Mean on a Bosch Washing Machine?
en.description: The complete Bosch code E:92/-01 means low water pressure or blocked water-inlet filters.
en.quick_fix: Record the complete code, check that the tap is fully open and inspect only the inlet hose and user-cleanable inlet filters described in the model manual (about 5–15 minutes).
en.intro_html:
The complete Bosch code E:92/-01 means low water pressure or blocked water-inlet filters. This guidance is based on Bosch support or an official model manual.

Record the complete code, check that the tap is fully open and inspect only the inlet hose and user-cleanable inlet filters described in the model manual. Do not remove panels, bypass safety devices or order a part from the code alone.

causes_json.detail: The complete Bosch code E:92/-01 means low water pressure or blocked water-inlet filters.
Permitted checks and component locations differ. The E-Nr identifies the correct manual.
If the code returns after documented user checks, it needs diagnosis rather than repeated resets.
The code alone does not confirm a replacement part. Internal electrical, lock, valve or motor work belongs with a technician.

steps_json.detail: Photograph E92, including punctuation and any suffix, and note the E-Nr from the rating plate.
Wait for the drum to stop. Do not force a locked door or handle water that may still be hot.
Record the complete code, check that the tap is fully open and inspect only the inlet hose and user-cleanable inlet filters described in the model manual.
Perform only the external checks and maintenance Bosch specifies for the exact E-Nr.

steps_json.action: Make at most one documented restart
steps_json.detail: Restart only if the manual permits it. Do not repeatedly reset a persistent fault.
Contact Bosch if the code remains, the manual directs you to service or the washer cannot be used safely.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange Bosch service if the code returns after the explicitly permitted user checks. F21 is a motor fault that Bosch directs to after-sales service.

Stop immediately for a burning smell, smoke, leakage, abnormal heat or a tripped supply. Do not remove panels or test internal parts.
en.prevention_html:
Follow the installation, load and maintenance instructions for the exact E-Nr. Keep the door opening clear, prevent hose kinks and clean only user-accessible filters described in the manual.

Record a recurring code and request diagnosis instead of repeatedly resetting the washer.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing E92?
faq_json.answer: Record the complete code, check that the tap is fully open and inspect only the inlet hose and user-cleanable inlet filters described in the model manual. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset E92 by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does E92 identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

en.h1: What Does F21 Mean on a Bosch Washing Machine?
en.description: An official Bosch washer manual identifies F21 as a motor fault.
en.quick_fix: Switch off, unplug and arrange Bosch service; do not attempt a motor repair yourself (about 5 minutes).
en.intro_html:
An official Bosch washer manual identifies F21 as a motor fault. This guidance is based on Bosch support or an official model manual.

Stop using the washer, switch it off and unplug it; Bosch instructs the user to contact after-sales service. Do not remove panels, bypass safety devices or order a part from the code alone.

causes_json.detail: An official Bosch washer manual identifies F21 as a motor fault.
Permitted checks and component locations differ. The E-Nr identifies the correct manual.
If the code returns after documented user checks, it needs diagnosis rather than repeated resets.
The code alone does not confirm a replacement part. Internal electrical, lock, valve or motor work belongs with a technician.

steps_json.detail: Photograph F21, including punctuation and any suffix, and note the E-Nr from the rating plate.
Wait for the drum to stop. Do not force a locked door or handle water that may still be hot.
Stop using the washer, switch it off and unplug it; Bosch instructs the user to contact after-sales service.
Perform only the external checks and maintenance Bosch specifies for the exact E-Nr.

steps_json.action: Make at most one documented restart
steps_json.detail: Restart only if the manual permits it. Do not repeatedly reset a persistent fault.
Contact Bosch if the code remains, the manual directs you to service or the washer cannot be used safely.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange Bosch service if the code returns after the explicitly permitted user checks. F21 is a motor fault that Bosch directs to after-sales service.

Stop immediately for a burning smell, smoke, leakage, abnormal heat or a tripped supply. Do not remove panels or test internal parts.
en.prevention_html:
Follow the installation, load and maintenance instructions for the exact E-Nr. Keep the door opening clear, prevent hose kinks and clean only user-accessible filters described in the manual.

Record a recurring code and request diagnosis instead of repeatedly resetting the washer.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing F21?
faq_json.answer: Stop using the washer, switch it off and unplug it; Bosch instructs the user to contact after-sales service. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset F21 by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does F21 identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.
